## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Relevant builds pass (`npm run build` for backend/web changes).
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` are updated when configuration changes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated build output, or populated `.env`
      files are included.

## Screenshots or API examples

Add evidence when the change affects UI or an API contract; otherwise write
`Not applicable`.
